title: Design: long and special tier names on the Tiers list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a long name with spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Tier).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a long name with no spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingTierPlanX).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier B's three-dot menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A's, tier B's and tier C's names can each be read in full or in part on their own row.
  • The name stays inside its own row: it never covers the next row or column.
  • Every column and every button of the row stays visible, and the page does not scroll sideways.
  • Tier C's name shows character for character as typed, & " ' < > included.
  • The Customers, Matrices and Status columns keep their places, as in picture 2.2.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens beside tier B's row, fully visible, with Audit Log, Archive and Delete.
